headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong AI‑driven expansion while others saw modest revenue gains.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin outlook. Infosys trimmed FY27 guidance to 1‑2% growth, reflecting slower top‑line momentum. Most peers posted double‑digit revenue growth, supported by AI‑related deals and higher margins. Profit growth varied, with HCLTech and OFSS delivering double‑digit jumps, while Wipro saw a slight profit dip.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI contributed significantly to top‑line growth, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin expansion
themes.detail: Coforge lifted its FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16% and HCLTech maintained an 18.2% operating margin.

themes.title: Guidance adjustments
themes.detail: Infosys cut its FY27 revenue growth guidance, while Mphasis raised its outlook to low double‑digit constant‑currency growth.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and upgraded EBIT margin guidance.
11.5% YoY revenue growth, 21% profit jump and strong AI revenue.

laggards.why: Only 1.5% YoY revenue growth and FY27 guidance cut to 1‑2%.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% and headcount declined.

domain_outlook.note: Mphasis highlighted telecom and device engineering as a growth driver.
